eyebrow: Q: "Tell me about a production incident you handled"
code:
S: checkout p99 spiked ~400ms -> 6.2s in a drill
T: find root cause fast, no alert pointed at it
A: golden signals + USE method -> traced to the
   inventory service's saturated DB connection pool
R: blameless postmortem -- new saturation alert +
   a circuit breaker in checkout
caption: The flash-sale incident drill, as a timed STAR answer

eyebrow: Q: "Describe a time you shifted security left"
code:
S: a PaymentPro API key was about to be committed
   in a Helm values file
T: our gitleaks pre-commit hook + CI scan exist
   exactly to catch this
A: gitleaks flagged it before it was ever pushed
R: no key rotation or history scrub needed --
   catching it at the source was cheap; cleaning
   it up after would not have been
caption: The near-miss secrets leak, as a timed STAR answer
